answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: agent earnings in a network like the willow marketplace or forge compute pool are locked and released linearly over many epochs. A zephyr reputation score multiplies rewards only for identities surviving those epochs of honest work. A flash-farming attacker must keep thousands of accounts productive for months before vesting unlocks, tying up capital and compute, and forfeits most earnings on cheat or exit. Attack cost approaches legitimate long-term value, so sybils stop being profitable.
